claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show wooden pallets stacked, consistent with stacking/base use

claims.claim: Available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: Location cannot be confirmed from photos; no address or geotag shown

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: No close-up showing moisture condition of all units; 'no water added' phrasing is unusual for pallets and not shown in any photo

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, reading, or weighing event visible in any photo

risks.risk: Total quantity for sale is unknown, affecting lot value
risks.proof: Wide shot showing all stacks with a visible count or seller stating exact unit number on camera
risks.if_unproven: price as smallest plausible lot (minimum visible stack)

risks.risk: Condition issues (cracks, missing boards, nail protrusions) not visible on every unit
risks.proof: Close-up photos/video of each stack's top, bottom and sides

risks.risk: Mixed authenticity - some pallets may be unmarked or counterfeit EPAL stamps
risks.proof: Clear close-up of each stamp showing EPAL oval, IPPC mark, country/plant code

risks.risk: Heat-treatment/ISPM 15 compliance unverified, affecting export-grade value
risks.proof: Visible HT stamp alongside EPAL mark in a clear photo

risks.risk: Weight/moisture claims cannot be confirmed remotely and seem template-like for this item type
risks.proof: Video of pallets being placed on a certified scale with reading visible
risks.if_unproven: exclude weight claim from valuation; price on visual condition only

proof_requests: Wide-angle photo showing all stacks together with a counted total
Close-up photos of every stamp (EPAL + HT/IPPC marks) on each stack
Video or photo of the pallets on the scale with the 500kg reading visible
Close-up shots of pallet undersides and edges for crack/board damage
response.reason: The witness confirms genuine EPAL-stamped wooden pallets, so the item can be priced at worst case for condition, quantity, and certification pending further proof; the seller's unverifiable weight and oddly-phrased moisture claim are flagged but do not amount to clear fraud.
